# Keyway

> Keyway is a free, open-source (MIT) local gateway for AI coding CLIs. It manages providers, model routing, failover and request logs for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and OpenClaw — switch providers without restarting sessions. API keys stay in an encrypted local database. Runs on macOS, Windows and Linux.

Keyway（AI CLI 的本地网关）通过本机代理（127.0.0.1:9527）接管 AI 编程 CLI 的请求：不重启会话即时切换供应商、按模型配置路由规则、自动故障转移、请求日志与 token 用量统计。API Key 存储于本机加密数据库（SQLCipher，主密钥由系统钥匙串保管），导出的配置不含 API Key。支持从 cc-switch 一键导入迁移。完全免费、开源（MIT）。

## Docs

- [Keyway 详细使用指南（中文）](https://keyway.one/guide.html): 安装、接管 CLI、切换供应商、验证请求去向、故障排查的完整指南
- [如何给 Claude Code 切换供应商（中文教程）](https://keyway.one/guides/claude-code-switch-provider.html): 不用重启会话，给 Claude Code 切换第三方供应商 / 中转站的完整步骤
- [How to Switch Claude Code Providers (English)](https://keyway.one/en/switch-claude-code-provider.html): Step-by-step guide to switching Claude Code providers (third-party endpoints, proxies) without restarting sessions
- [English site](https://keyway.one/en/): Keyway — Local gateway for Claude Code, Codex & Gemini CLI

## Blog — AI CLI provider configuration series (中文)

- [博客首页](https://keyway.one/blog/): 「AI CLI 供应商配置图解」系列(6 篇)
- [换一家 AI 供应商,要动哪三个地方?](https://keyway.one/blog/switch-provider-by-hand.html): Base URL / API Key / 协议与三系统差异,系列总起
- [Codex 手动换供应商:config.toml 逐行讲解](https://keyway.one/blog/codex-provider-by-hand.html): ~/.codex/config.toml、model_providers、env_key、验证与报错对照
- [Claude Code 手动换供应商](https://keyway.one/blog/claude-code-provider-by-hand.html): settings.json env 块、ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL / AUTH_TOKEN / API_KEY、单一定义源
- [Gemini CLI 手动换供应商](https://keyway.one/blog/gemini-cli-provider-by-hand.html): ~/.gemini/.env、GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL、API Key 与 OAuth
- [为什么改了配置没生效?](https://keyway.one/blog/why-config-not-applied.html): 三层快照与五步排查法
- [三家配置对照总表与管理工具原理](https://keyway.one/blog/ai-cli-provider-cheatsheet.html): 收官篇:对照表 + 本地代理原理

## Blog — AI CLI provider configuration series (English)

- [Blog home](https://keyway.one/en/blog/): the 6-part series
- [Switching AI providers: the three things you must change](https://keyway.one/en/blog/switch-provider-by-hand.html): Base URL, API key, protocol — and per-OS locations
- [Codex, by hand: config.toml](https://keyway.one/en/blog/codex-provider-by-hand.html): model_providers, env_key, verification, error table
- [Claude Code, by hand: settings.json vs env vars](https://keyway.one/en/blog/claude-code-provider-by-hand.html): env block, AUTH_TOKEN vs API_KEY, single source of truth
- [Gemini CLI, by hand: .env and two auth modes](https://keyway.one/en/blog/gemini-cli-provider-by-hand.html): GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL, API key vs OAuth
- [Why config changes don't apply](https://keyway.one/en/blog/why-config-not-applied.html): three snapshot layers, five-step diagnostic
- [The cheat sheet and how manager tools work](https://keyway.one/en/blog/ai-cli-provider-cheatsheet.html): wrap-up + local proxy explained
